notes: Five display faults, found by opening the app and reading the screen rather than checking that requests returned 200. The Setups panel was crushed into a strip: the cards sit in a grid where each has to be told how many rows it spans, and the Setups tab skipped that step (the Telemetry panel did it), so the whole sheet was squeezed into a 42-pixel box holding 825 pixels of content while 900 pixels of panel sat empty below. It now fills the panel in three columns. The lap table hid half its columns - 520 pixels for 913 pixels of table on a 1920-wide screen, so brake events, trailbrake, lateral g, shifts, fuel and incidents could only be reached by finding a horizontal scrollbar; eleven of fourteen are now simply visible and the map keeps its size. The track map said "You ran nanm tighter through here than your reference" - a missing number passed a guard that tested for absent but not for nonsense; it now says there is no position data, which is true. The corner tree never loaded: it ran before the reference list arrived, printed "pick a reference with corner data" and never tried again, so it contradicted the Virtual Best named directly above it. And the empty Telemetry and Setups panels now read START DRIVING, OR PICK A SESSION ON THE LEFT, bold and uppercase at up to 32 pixels instead of 13. Everything from 0.9.166 and 0.9.167 is included.
